description: Logical failures of the cluster-sampled points of Fig. 4 (p = 0.002-0.003), aggregated over the per-shard outputs of the batched two-stage decoder (scripts/ler/l33/run_batched.py). Each failure is keyed by its observable mistake mask: one character per observable, 'E' = wrong, '_' = right; the first 148 observables are the block logicals, the remaining ones (33, surgery X only) the time-like fibre readouts.

columns.relay_failures: shots on which Relay-BP converged to a wrong correction (T1)
columns.lsd_failures: shots on which Relay-BP did not converge and BP-LSD was wrong (T2)
